title: ReadStack Ed25519 policy envelope v1
description: The App enforces a 786432-byte UTF-8 envelope limit and authenticates decoded payload bytes against an independently configured 32-byte public key. A matching schema is not evidence of a valid signature.

payload.description: Canonical standard base64 of the complete, nonempty payload UTF-8 bytes; no base64url or whitespace. Decoded payload is at most 524288 bytes.

signature.description: Canonical standard base64 of exactly 64 Ed25519 signature bytes.
